title: Compare and Deploy AI Models on Souvenir
overview: Run the same prompt across GPT, Claude, and Gemini side by side, then deploy the model that wins — without leaving the chat.

steps.text: Firstly, click the Compare Models button to evaluate different AI model options.
Following that, click GPT-5 Mini to view its features and specifications.
From here, click the Anthropic filter to view only Anthropic models available for comparison.
Now, click on Google to view and select the Gemini 3.5 Flash model option.
Now, click the Test models button to run a comparison of your selected models.
Next up, click the message input field to ask a question about model performance.
After that, click the Send button to submit your prompt and view model results.
From here, click the expand icon to view detailed model comparison metrics and performance data.
After that, click the "Use this model" button to deploy the selected AI model.
Next up, select Claude Sonnet 4.6 to choose your preferred AI model.
From here, type your question or request in the message input field below.
